assessment_title: Life Sciences Grade 12 Term 3 Catalogue-Aligned Controlled Test
topics: Evolution by natural selection and speciation
methodology_topic: Interpreting biological diagrams, data tables and graphs from DBE-style papers
essay_topic: Use evidence from diagrams, tables and investigation data to explain biological change over time
additional_instructions: Build a CAPS-aligned Grade 12 Term 3 Life Sciences controlled test. Use the local FET old-paper source catalogue as the evidence-shape authority: include labelled biological diagrams, a data table or graph stimulus, and an investigation/data-response item. Do not reference missing visuals. Include a complete memo with mark allocation and accept scientifically equivalent wording.
